result.description: The NovaPulse AuroraLink is a fictional 34-inch curved ultrawide monitor designed for immersive desktop productivity and entertainment. It features a 3440 x 1440 IPS panel, 165Hz refresh rate, 1ms response time, USB-C display input with 90W power delivery, and integrated KVM support for switching between two connected systems. The matte black chassis includes adjustable height, tilt, and swivel, plus VESA 100x100 mounting compatibility for flexible workspace setups.
